answer: Escrowed admission on a referral trellis stops fakes. A newcomer posts a 60 POA bond and names a sponsor, published as a beacon record. The trellis links sponsors to recruits; 100 under one sponsor are flagged. Peers may dispute: a proven fake loses its bond, its sponsor half of theirs, and a ripple of penalties hits the cluster. 1,000 fakes cost 90,000 POA, 30x the 3,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays one bond, refunded after 20 epochs.
